summary: ASTRA-MED is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring system designed to support continuous health assessment during space missions. The platform integrates real-time vital sign monitoring, intelligent health evaluation, visual screening, and offline-first functionality. It tracks essential health indicators, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, body temperature, sleep, radiation exposure, and psychological well-being. Its biomedical engine evaluates four health zones-head, heart, bones, and immune system-to identify potential health risks and detect abnormal trends. Additionally, the AI Medic provides health-related guidance, while eye and skin scanners support image-based screening. A voice assistant enables hands-free interaction, and an offline-first architecture ensures essential functions remain accessible without internet connectivity. ASTRA-MED addresses the challenges of limited medical resources, communication delays, and health risks in space environments. By combining AI, local data processing, and intelligent monitoring, the system aims to support early risk detection, informed medical decision-making, and improved astronaut health and safety during long-duration space missions.
details:
ASTRA-MED is an AI-powered astronaut health monitoring system that collects and analyzes vital signs, monitors four major body zones, detects unusual health trends, and provides intelligent guidance through its AI Medic. It also includes eye and skin scanners, a voice assistant for hands-free interaction, and offline functionality to ensure continuous access without internet connectivity. The project aims to improve early risk detection, support medical decision-making, and enhance astronaut safety during long-duration space missions. It was developed using React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, SQLite, and local AI models such as Ollama. Its creativity lies in combining biomedical monitoring, AI-assisted analysis, visual screening, voice interaction, and offline-first technology in one platform. Key considerations included data privacy, system reliability, accessibility, usability, and the unique health challenges of space environments.

Crew Daily Check-In & Mission Overview

Biometric & Habitat Vitals Input Sliders

(Interactive "Update Your Readings" panel for adjusting heart rate, blood pressure, temperature, blood sugar, sleep, workout, SpO2, and radiation)

Piloting Reflex Test & Mood Assessment

(15-Second Piloting & Reflex Test, mood selector cards, and "Simulate Space Emergency" / "Analyze My Health" controls)

Body Scanner: Neuro-Ocular Telemetry Summary

(System layer filters alongside recorded sleep, intraocular pressure, optic nerve sheath, and reflex readings)

3D Interactive Body Scanner & Immediate Action Plan

(Full-body anatomical visualization, subsystem status indicators, space hazard connection, and step-by-step clinical guidance)

Personal AI Medic (Offline Voice & Medical Companion)

(Local AI engine configuration with Ollama fallback, ASTRA Core offline mode, and conversational medical assistant)

Mission Health Log & Daily Mission Routine

(7-day longitudinal heart rate metrics paired with the crew readiness checklist and 6-day streak tracker)

7-Day Longitudinal Trend: Sleep Hours

(Daily sleep duration tracking plotted against the 7.5-hour mission target)

7-Day Longitudinal Trend: Stress Score

(Behavioral stress score progression plotted against the caution threshold)

Visual Skin & Ocular Diagnostic Scanner

(Optical screening module supporting live webcam capture, local photo upload, and SANS/dermatology checks)
